title: Identify the energy defect as an atom at infinity and superquadratic moment divergence
statement: Under the already accepted global classical Coulomb LFD trajectory and all-time L1_q convergence for q<2 to F_*, set u=P/M and Delta=E-E_*>=0. On the one-point compactification of velocity space, mu_t(dv)=integral_x |v-u|^2 f(t,x,v) dx dv converges weak-star to |v-u|^2 F_*(v) dv+Delta delta_infinity. A positive Delta forces integral |v-u|^q f(t) to diverge for every q>2. Mass, momentum and entropy have no corresponding escape under the accepted conservation and entropy-tail estimates. This is an alternative conditional on the unresolved Delta, not a constructed trajectory with energy escape.
